name: Google
description: Leading technology company known for search, cloud computing, and AI innovation.
interviewOverview: 5 rounds: Phone Screen, 2 Technical Coding, System Design, Behavioral (Googleyness & Leadership). Focus on algorithms, data structures, and scalability.

name: Amazon
description: Global e-commerce and cloud computing giant with strong leadership principles culture.
interviewOverview: 5 rounds: Online Assessment, Phone Screen, 4 Loop Interviews (mix of coding and behavioral). Heavy emphasis on Leadership Principles (LP).

name: Microsoft
description: Technology corporation known for Windows, Azure, and enterprise software solutions.
interviewOverview: 4 rounds: Phone Screen, 2-3 Technical Interviews, As-Appropriate (final round with senior leader). Focus on coding, design, and collaboration.

name: Meta
description: Social technology company building products for connecting people globally.
interviewOverview: 4 rounds: Phone Screen, 2 Coding Interviews, System Design, Behavioral. Strong emphasis on move-fast culture and impact.

name: Netflix
description: Streaming entertainment service known for freedom and responsibility culture.
interviewOverview: 3 rounds: Phone Screen, Technical Deep Dive, Culture Fit. Values context over control, seeks senior-level judgment.

name: Flipkart
description: India's leading e-commerce marketplace and Walmart subsidiary.
interviewOverview: 4 rounds: Online Assessment, Machine Coding, System Design, HR/Managerial. Strong focus on problem-solving and scalable design.

name: Goldman Sachs
description: Global investment banking and financial services company.
interviewOverview: 4 rounds: Online Assessment (HackerRank), Technical Rounds (2), HR Round. Focus on DSA, OOP, and analytical thinking.

name: Apple
description: Consumer technology company known for hardware, software, and design excellence.
interviewOverview: 4 rounds: Phone Screen, Technical Coding, System Design, Team Match. Values attention to detail and user-centric thinking.
